presets.name: context7
presets.description: Up-to-date library and framework documentation fetched on demand (stops the model guessing outdated APIs).
presets.usage: Add 'use context7' to a prompt, or ask for the current docs of a library.

presets.name: playwright
presets.description: Drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots. Lets the agent verify web UIs itself.
presets.usage: Ask: 'open http://localhost:3000 and check the signup flow at mobile width'. First run may download browsers.
